source.excerpt: 晏子為齊相，出，其御之妻從門閒而闚其夫。其夫為相御，擁大蓋，策駟馬，意氣揚揚甚自得也。既而歸，其妻請去。夫問其故。妻曰：「晏子長不滿六尺，身相齊國，名顯諸侯。今者妾觀其出，志念深矣，常有以自下者。今子長八尺，乃為人仆御，然子之意自以為足，妾是以求去也。」其後夫自抑損。晏子怪而問之，御以實對。晏子薦以為大夫。
source.transcriptionNote: 复用现有已录入批次的逐字原文快照；底本定位、原件哈希及行号保留。电子本尚不宣称纸本异文全校。

panels.title: 驾着四匹马
panels.caption: 晏子出行，车夫坐在车前，驾着四匹马，神气十足。
panels.scene: Wide ancient street: a tall proud driver in ochre sits in FRONT of a covered carriage pulled by FOUR horses; small dignified Yan Ying sits quietly in rear compartment.

evidence.excerpt: 策駟馬，意氣揚揚甚自得也

panels.title: 门缝里的目光
panels.caption: 车夫的妻子从门缝里，看见了丈夫得意的模样。
panels.scene: Green-robed wife peers through a wooden gate gap toward her proud driver husband and the passing carriage.

evidence.excerpt: 其御之妻從門閒而闚其夫

panels.title: 妻子要离开
panels.caption: 车夫回到家，妻子却提出想要离开他。
panels.scene: Simple home interior: green-robed wife speaks firmly to astonished tall driver, no packed modern luggage.

panels.title: 为什么呢
panels.caption: 丈夫很惊讶，连忙问她原因。
panels.scene: Close view of driver looking puzzled, hands open toward composed wife across a modest wooden table.

panels.title: 看看晏子
panels.caption: 妻子说：“晏子身为齐相，名声显著，出门时却总是谦逊自持。”
panels.scene: Wife calmly explains, small visual view through doorway toward distant Yan Ying seated humbly in courtyard, not a second simultaneous wife.

panels.title: 再看看自己
panels.caption: “你只是替人驾车，却这么自满。我因此才想离开。”
panels.scene: Wife speaks directly and earnestly to husband; he lowers his proud posture and looks thoughtful.

evidence.excerpt: 然子之意自以為足，妾是以求去也

panels.title: 他真的改了
panels.caption: 此后，车夫收敛了自己的骄气。晏子觉得奇怪，便问他发生了什么。
panels.scene: Later: driver stands humbly beside carriage with lowered shoulders; dignified Yan Ying asks him a question, warm attentive expressions.

evidence.excerpt: 其後夫自抑損。晏子怪而問之

panels.title: 听进劝告的人
panels.caption: 车夫如实讲述。晏子听后，推荐他担任大夫。
panels.scene: Final respectful scene: driver gives honest account, Yan Ying nods approvingly with one open hand. They stand at carriage side; no instant crown or invented ceremony.

evidence.excerpt: 御以實對。晏子薦以為大夫

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua story atlas, exactly 8 sequential illustrations on ONE image. Primary request: 晏子的车夫. Composition: STRICT equal rectangular grid of TWO columns and 4 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. All row heights equal, all column widths equal. Canvas target 1024 x 1280. Narrow straight cream gutters, maximum 4 pixels; no outer margin, no header/footer; every scene fills its own complete LANDSCAPE cell. No merged panels, insets, or changes in layout.
Style: classic 1950s-1960s Chinese small-picture storybook, early Shanghai Animation folk-art sensibility. Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.
Characters and invariants: Yan Ying: mature dignified scholar of short stature, deep blue robe, modest dark cap, gray short beard. His driver: tall adult man in ochre tunic with rust waist belt and cloth cap, same adult face throughout; operates ONE ancient carriage drawn by FOUR horses, never a modern buggy. Driver wife: adult woman in muted green robe, simple hair bun. Yan Ying rides inside rear compartment, driver sits at front outside. Respectful portrayal of all bodies.
Scenes in this exact order:
1. Wide ancient street: a tall proud driver in ochre sits in FRONT of a covered carriage pulled by FOUR horses; small dignified Yan Ying sits quietly in rear compartment.
2. Green-robed wife peers through a wooden gate gap toward her proud driver husband and the passing carriage.
3. Simple home interior: green-robed wife speaks firmly to astonished tall driver, no packed modern luggage.
4. Close view of driver looking puzzled, hands open toward composed wife across a modest wooden table.
5. Wife calmly explains, small visual view through doorway toward distant Yan Ying seated humbly in courtyard, not a second simultaneous wife.
6. Wife speaks directly and earnestly to husband; he lowers his proud posture and looks thoughtful.
7. Later: driver stands humbly beside carriage with lowered shoulders; dignified Yan Ying asks him a question, warm attentive expressions.
8. Final respectful scene: driver gives honest account, Yan Ying nods approvingly with one open hand. They stand at carriage side; no instant crown or invented ceremony.

styleRefinement.instructions: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle ONLY IMAGE 1, the edit target. IMAGE 2 (approved older 移木立信 artwork) is the PRIMARY style reference; IMAGE 3 (newly corrected fish-refusal artwork) is a SECONDARY reference for the same approved style. Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.
